cards.card_text: The nations Israel will drive out listen to conjurers and diviners.
cards.verse_text: Though these nations, which you will dispossess, listen to conjurers and diviners, the LORD your God has not permitted you to do so.
cards.snippet: Though these nations, which you will dispossess, listen to conjurers and diviners, the LORD your God has not permitted you to do so.

cards.card_text: Tucked into Reuben's list is a surprise: the Israelites also killed the diviner Balaam son of Beor.
cards.verse_text: The Israelites also killed the diviner Balaam son of Beor along with the others they put to the sword.

cards.card_text: After seven months in their land, the Philistines call in their priests and diviners and ask what to do with the ark and how to send it back to its place.
cards.verse_text: When the ark of the LORD had been in the land of the Philistines seven months, the Philistines summoned the priests and diviners, saying, “What shall we do with the ark of the LORD?
cards.snippet: …land of the Philistines seven months, the Philistines summoned the priests and diviners, saying, “What shall we do with the ark of the LORD?

cards.card_text: Next on His list: false prophets, diviners and the people who think they're wise.

cards.card_text: Then the message warns: don't listen to your prophets, your diviners, your dream interpreters, your mediums or your sorcerers.
cards.verse_text: But as for you, do not listen to your prophets, your diviners, your interpreters of dreams, your mediums, or your sorcerers who declare, ‘You will not serve the king of Babylon.’

cards.card_text: Then the letter turns to the prophets and diviners right there among the exiles.
cards.verse_text: For this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: “Do not be deceived by the prophets and diviners among you, and do not listen to the dreams you elicit from them.

cards.card_text: The LORD tells the exiles to listen closely to the dreams they get from those prophets and diviners.

cards.card_text: When the king tells his dream to the magicians, enchanters, astrologers and diviners, they are able to interpret it for him.
cards.verse_text: When the magicians, enchanters, astrologers, and diviners came in, I told them the dream, but they could not interpret it for me.
cards.snippet: When the magicians, enchanters, astrologers, and diviners came in, I told them the dream, but they could not interpret…

cards.card_text: Once the visions are gone, the seers and diviners are honored for their honesty.
cards.verse_text: Then the seers will be ashamed and the diviners will be disgraced.
cards.snippet: Then the seers will be ashamed and the diviners will be disgraced.

cards.card_text: The seers and diviners all end up covering their mouths.
cards.verse_text: Then the seers will be ashamed and the diviners will be disgraced.
cards.snippet: Then the seers will be ashamed and the diviners will be disgraced.

cards.card_text: But then the message turns to idols and diviners.
cards.verse_text: For idols speak deceit and diviners see illusions; they tell false dreams and offer empty comfort.
